title: Creating PAC (Phase-Amplitude Coupling) graphs using EEGlab.
author: Kim, Ho Jeong
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Create timeline from open‑Ephy epochs
steps.instruction: Process the data generated with open‑Ephy by constructing a timeline that aligns with each stimulation point (epoch); for example, if there are 600 epochs, generate a timeline vector covering all 600 epochs.

steps.title: Segment, average, and plot PAC graphs
steps.instruction: Take the phase (x), amplitude (y), and time (z) data produced in the first step, divide each axis into the desired segment lengths, compute the average across those segments, and visualize the resulting phase‑amplitude coupling graph.
